projects.codeSnippet:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_calc_invoice_total
AFTER INSERT ON RoomReservations
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    UPDATE Invoices 
    SET TotalAmount = TotalAmount + (NEW.Nights * NEW.NightlyRate)
    WHERE GuestID = NEW.GuestID;
END;
